component.name: Yakumo
component.summary: Native port of Monster Hunter Portable 3rd HD Ver.

description.p: Yakumo is a native port of Monster Hunter Portable 3rd HD Ver. made by static recompilation: the game's PSP code is translated ahead of time into native code and runs on a reimplementation of the PSP system software, with Vulkan graphics, gamepad support and PSP-compatible saves.

Yakumo does not include any game assets or original game files: no disc image, no copy of the game's executable or data, and no textures, models, audio or video from the game. You must provide the files from your own legally obtained copy of Monster Hunter Portable 3rd HD Ver. (NPJB-40001): the first start checks that copy, accepts only the original release, and sets the game up from it.
Yakumo is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by CAPCOM or Sony.
